usage: 木 is the basic noun for “wood” or “timber”; it often refers to the material, not the living tree.
It is commonly used in compounds about materials, furniture, buildings, and tools, such as wooden objects or wood products.
In everyday Cantonese, 木 sounds natural in simple, concrete contexts; for more specific meanings, people may use other words like 木頭 in some speech.
When talking about plants or gardening, 木 can describe the hard woody part of a plant or the wood material from trees; it is usually not used for the whole tree itself.
